Hi, I’m Danielle Marie McAllister, a Canadian citizen living in Toronto. I’m planning a 14-day trip to England from **June 10, 2026 to June 24, 2026**, mainly for tourism in London and nearby day trips, and I may also have a few informal networking meetings with healthcare supply-chain contacts (no paid work). I work full-time as a **Procurement Specialist at Northern HealthCare Solutions Inc.**, and I’ll fund the trip myself (about **6,500 CAD** available for travel). My current Canadian passport is **KJ482931** (issued **2021-04-30**, expires **2031-04-30**), and I’m applying for a **6-month multiple-entry Standard Visitor visa**.

Please help me fill out the **England_visa_form**.
